boundaries: Real PowerSync SQLite/queue; fixture downloads are authorized snapshots, not PowerSync read replication.
Native checks exercise mutation code in convex-test, not a disposable live deployment.
Two browser contexts exercise normal downloaded-meeting edits and file transfer through the fixture.
PWA tests cover built shell and new-tab offline startup after initial online installation; not OS installation, physical devices, full process termination or pending-work upgrade qualification.
Live connector, credential and configuration adapters compile; real broker signing and live stream authorization are not exercised.
Permission projection is bounded and rebuilds explicitly after fixture ACL/identity changes. Production invalidation/expiry paths are not integrated.
Conflict/rejection recovery preserves FIFO queue and supports export; no merge/rebase/discard workflow.
Cloud scale, browser eviction, encrypted cache/logout policy, packaged Electron and Zoer rollout remain unverified.
